articles.title: Binance phishes its own staff monthly, India censors BitChat code: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Binance has been phishing its own staff to get ahead of potential attacks. South Korean crypto volumes tank 89% — plus all of the week’s other crypto news from Asia.

articles.title: New York AG warns CLARITY Act could weaken state crypto enforcement
articles.snippet: New York Attorney General Letitia James said the federal crypto market structure bill could restrict state regulators and urged Congress to impose stronger consumer protections on digital asset platforms.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward acquires Magic Labs’ wallet business
articles.snippet: The deal brings wallet technology to Payward’s enterprise platform, potentially reducing the number of infrastructure providers businesses need to integrate with.
